title: swfscDAS 0.7.0
text: Fixed bug das_process incorrect OffsetGMT values, stemming .Date using ‘UTC’ tz default (#16) Fixed bug das_segdata actually use last condition value segment length zero (#27) Added exported function das_spcodes_read consistent reading shipboard SpCode files Changed argument name das_check user-provided SpCodes file sp.codes sp.codes.file. Also added sp.codes.skip argument pass das_spcodes_read Added ‘SwellDir’ (Event V, Data 3) ‘WindDir’ (Event W, Data 4) output das_process (#21) Changed behavior das_effort seg0.drop argument TRUE. Now, segments distance traveled <=0.1 km, either ) dropped associated sighting events dropped, b) associated sightings kept given distance 0.1km. behavior matches historical SWFSC segment chopping logic (#22) Added optional argument gs.sp.min1 das_sight, allow user choose set minimum value non-NA species group size values 1. functionality important group size calibration efforts. Users can also specify argument das_effort, passed das_sight creating sightinfo data frame (#26) Added ‘Trackline’ (Event R, Data 3)output das_process (#10) Moved example data files ‘extdata’ folder within ‘inst’ Update link NOAA Tech Memo describing DAS data; now https://repository.library.noaa.gov/view/noaa/3174 Update roxygen use markdown, fix documentation issues related upgrade roxygen2 v8 Added SpCodes.dat file (CruzPlot) ‘inst’ available default Changed using R native pipe, updated package dependency require R >= 4.1
